blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever uma biografia filosófica de Simone de Beauvoir, usando voz passiva, orações relativas e linguagem de síntese, com entonação adequada.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Simone de Beauvoir (1908–1986)
paras: Simone de Beauvoir, **born** in Paris in 1908, **studied** philosophy at the Sorbonne and **went on to teach** it in secondary schools. **Her partnership with Jean-Paul Sartre**, **which lasted** until his death, **was** intellectual as well as personal. In *The Ethics of Ambiguity* (1947) she **argued** that freedom is **achieved** only **through** the freedom of others.

Her best-known work, *The Second Sex* (1949), **examined** how women **have been defined** in relation to men. Its most-quoted line, “One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman,” **has been** debated ever since. **She also wrote** novels; *The Mandarins* **received** the Prix Goncourt in 1954. **Widely regarded** as a **founding voice** of modern feminism, she **died** in Paris in 1986.

items.q: Beauvoir studied philosophy at the Sorbonne.
The Second Sex was published in 1947.
The text says she married Sartre.

blocks.body: A **passiva** põe a ideia em foco; **orações relativas** entre vírgulas acrescentam informação extra. O **presente perfeito** (*has been debated*) mostra que a discussão continua.
Relativa **não restritiva** exige vírgulas e não usa *that*: *…, which lasted…* ✓, *…, that lasted…* ✗.

items.s: Freedom is ___ through the freedom of others. (achieve)
Her partnership, ___ lasted until his death, was important. (which)
Women have been ___ in relation to men. (define)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Which book is she best known for
items.pt: Por qual livro ela é mais conhecida?

items.ans: And what is her most-quoted line
items.pt: E qual é a frase mais citada?

body: **Go on to.** — Passar a.
**Widely regarded as.** — Amplamente considerado.
**Break new ground.** — Abrir caminho.
**Make a name for oneself.** — Fazer nome.
**Leave one’s mark.** — Deixar sua marca.
**Be ahead of the curve.** — Estar à frente.
**Speak truth to power.** — Dizer a verdade ao poder.
**Stand apart.** — Destacar-se.
**Spark a movement.** — Deflagrar um movimento.
**Rise to prominence.** — Ganhar destaque.
**Which book is she best known for?** — Por qual livro ela é mais conhecida?
**And what is her most-quoted line?** — E qual é a frase mais citada?
**The Second Sex, which examined how women have been defined.** — O Segundo Sexo, que examinou como as mulheres foram definidas.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence biography of a woman or man whose life you know well (facts you are sure of), using a passive, a non-defining relative clause and go on to.
blocks.model: Frida Kahlo, who was born in Mexico City in 1907, began painting after a serious accident. Her work is often described as deeply personal. She went on to exhibit in Paris and New York. Self-portraits were central to her output. She is widely regarded as an icon of Mexican art. She died in 1954.
